messages: The HR statistics view shows actual and target hours and the difference for a selected period. A bar chart and an expandable table show how hours change over time. The custom period defaults to the start of the month through today. This month, This year and Previous year are also available. The statistics use the employee list's status filter and name search. Current hour balances are available separately.
Reminder emails and the personal weekly summary can be edited for each language and reset to the original text for that language. Emails are sent in the recipient's Nextcloud account language.
The HR overview shows active employees by default when opened or when the filters are reset.
Version history opens in the current app view without reloading the page. The three latest versions are available directly. Earlier entries can be expanded under Older versions.
When HR group rules are saved, a clear confirmation now appears at the bottom centre of the screen.
The HR employee list now loads on PostgreSQL when the weekend and public holiday rule is enabled.

Employees and HR receive reminders for individual missing or incomplete time entries.
Freelancer mode is now available.
HR can filter employees by activity or freelancer status and search by name.
Employees have a guided tour and email links for contacting HR.

Break display preferences are saved for each account.

View changes
HR responsibility can be assigned to groups and individual accounts.
HR email recipients can be selected separately for each rule.
HR can review changes to assigned employee time entries and work settings, including previous and new values.
HR changes are kept for twelve months; deleted accounts are removed or anonymised.
Access checks for employee entries and work settings follow HR responsibility.
HR list warnings and Monday emails now use shared thresholds.
The HR recipient search suggests matching accounts while typing.
Timesheets are easier to read on small screens.
HR can customise reminder emails and individual sections of the weekly summary.
The comment menu offers vacation, sickness, appointments and custom comments. The three preset reasons prevent reminders when both times are missing.
The HR overview includes inactive employees, has an adjustable width and offers a statistics button.
HR can search for employees and editors in the change history. Inactive employees can be selected, and the editor filter lists HR accounts.
The guided tour explains the comment menu and entry warnings in separate steps.
HR statistics correctly count hours worked in the current month.
The width slider keeps the same setting for the timesheet, HR overview and change history after signing in again.
Details buttons take up less space in the change history table.
Help for the HR overview is available beside the employee list at any width.
Comments can be entered as free text again. The comment help explains which absence reasons prevent reminders when both times are missing.
Reminders for missing or incomplete time entries use an updated default message for employees.
Fixed a PostgreSQL error in the HR employee list when monthly balances are recalculated after a change to target hours.

Reminder rules have changed. Any comment with content now suppresses the email reminder for missing or incomplete time entries, replacing the previous list of reasons. If only the start or end time is missing, the incomplete time warning appears only when the Comment column is empty.

The HR overview and change history show active and inactive employees based on the Zeitnachweis and Zeitnachweis-Archiv groups. Both views can be filtered by All, Active and Inactive. Visibility follows the HR assignment.
Nextcloud accounts can belong to Zeitnachweis and Zeitnachweis-Archiv at the same time. Accounts remain active while they belong to Zeitnachweis. Removing that membership leaves them in the archive.
The comment help, guided tour and group rule example explain the new reminder rule.
The HR help explains that thresholds are set per HR account and the weekly summary email goes to that account.
Open release notes from the Nextcloud bell. Select View changes to open the expandable version history.
Administrators can choose existing Nextcloud groups for active and inactive employees in each HR rule.
The HR overview and change history show employees with both memberships as active and list each employee once under All.
Existing HR rules keep their current status behaviour until their employee group selection changes.
Update notices stay in the Nextcloud bell. View changes opens the expandable version history.
The guided tour can be dismissed permanently and restarted at any time.
The change history table gives editor names more space. The HR help explains where break rules are configured.
